display_name.ru: Sia12 — BIP39 encoding, BLAKE2b entropy seed

position_rules: 128 entropy bits and4 SHA256 checksum bits;12 English11-bit indices.

external_secret.guidance: No mnemonic derivation extension in this exact mode. Local storage/unlock passwords are separate; never enter them into Tessaveil.

semantic_distinction: BLAKE2b-256 over entropy yields Sia32-byte seed. Not standard BIP39 sentence PBKDF2; no passphrase.
